title: K2 Space hero
description: A window-tall hero over full-bleed footage: a single colossal two-word line (213px at 1440, 14.8vw) in soft grey, centred and framed by four hairline corner brackets that span the width. Phones stack the two words at 92px inside a smaller bracket frame. No motion of its own; the footage carries it.
notes: always dark (it carries the `dark` class): light type over footage in either mode
media fills the hero like object-fit cover; empty it is a dark placeholder with a soft glow
pair with k2space-header, which floats over it
name: k2space-hero

props.name: title
props.description: the giant line (two short words read best: phones stack them)

props.name: media
props.description: the full-bleed video or photo behind it
